notes.general: On this desktop these settings take effect. Ask to keep changes is TextEdit's, whose documents have files; Close windows brings back the windows, as each application keeps its own contents.
notes.desktop-and-screen-saver: On this desktop only the desktop picture, its Dynamic, Light or Dark setting, Change picture and the screen saver take effect. This pane's other settings are kept for your account, but change nothing here.
notes.dock: On this desktop these settings take effect. Prefer tabs is for Terminal: Finder and Safari have settings of their own, and the other applications have no tabs.
notes.mission-control: On this desktop the shortcuts, Hot Corners and Group windows by application take effect. The dimmed settings are what this desktop always does.
notes.siri: Enable Ask Siri, Listen for “Hey Siri”, Language, Siri Voice, Voice Feedback and Show Siri in menu bar take effect here. Hey Siri listens only while this page is open; your browser's recognizer may send what it hears to its maker.
notes.spotlight: On this desktop Search Results and Privacy take effect. There are no suggestions to allow, as the dimmed setting says.
notes.language-and-region: On this desktop Region and Calendar write the examples and Today's date, and First day of week and 24-Hour Time take effect. The dimmed settings say why.
notes.notifications: On this desktop From, When the display is sleeping, the two call settings, each application's settings and the sort order take effect. The dimmed settings say why.
notes.accessibility: On this desktop only Display, Speech, Audio, Zoom, Captions and Show Accessibility status in menu bar take effect. This pane's other settings are kept for your account, but change nothing here.
notes.extensions: On this desktop only the Share Menu and Today take effect. This pane's other settings are kept for your account, but change nothing here.
notes.security-and-privacy: On this desktop only Require password, the lock message and the Advanced settings take effect. This pane's other settings are kept for your account, but change nothing here.
notes.sound: On this desktop these settings govern what the desktop itself plays. A web page cannot reach your computer's sound device or volume.
notes.keyboard: On this desktop the Text tab, Dictation's On, Off and Language, and the viewers' check box take effect. The dimmed settings are your computer's, which a web page cannot read or change.
notes.trackpad: The dimmed settings are your computer's, which a web page cannot read or change.
notes.mouse: On this desktop only Scroll direction takes effect. The dimmed settings are your computer's, which a web page cannot read or change.
notes.sidecar: This pane's settings are kept for your account, but change nothing on this desktop.
